title: s27 drift deconvolution: the census drift is a far-side count structure at g ~ [1e6G, 1e11G] (pole family fits to ~1%); s28 transition-window census launched to pin the location
body:
s27 deconvolved the s25/s26 drift through the engine's OWN exact kernel (the s19/s19b analytic anti-derivative machinery, copied verbatim), with A/B anchored to the near face (t/G < 2.2) by lstsq (A = -2.527100e7, B = +5.238779e8, max near res 1124).

Unit resolution (engine-native probe, no hand normalization): one count offset of 1 zero at g0 >> t shifts M by O(1e-4 .. 1e-2) at the census heights via the far kernel; the P1 pole fits' effective masses therefore read directly in zero counts.

Part B (parametric forward fits on the 12 far rows, t/G = 2e3 .. 5e7):
  -  P1 (localized count pole at h0): the drift is reproduced to max|res| ~ 2.5e5 (~1% of the drift amplitude 2.41e7) for h0 in a wide band ~ [2e8G, 2e11G], with effective count offsets ~ +2.7e8 zeros (at 2e8G) up to ~ +2.4e11 zeros (at 5e9G) -- the position-amplitude degeneracy of a single parameter. The fit degrades outside that band (7.6e6 at 5e6G, 1.9e7 at 2e14G).
  -  The drift shape (with the near-face anchor) is a crossing, not a turn-on: D(t) ~ +2e5 plateau through t ~ 2e6G (within the O(1e5-6e5) anchor uncertainty of the ln law), crossing to negative between 5e6G and 7e6G, then the t^2-like growth (per-doubling ratios 4.1 / 4.0 / 6.3). For a far-count pole the zero crossing of D(t) sits at the structure's transition -- this points the location to h0 ~ [3e6G, 2e7G] (= 1e17 .. 6e17, between the 1e6G and 2e7G measured rows; for rows with t > h0 the offset is in-band and the kernel changes character). The pole-band fit (h0 in [2e8G, 2e11G], all far-side) is the degenerate alternative that a single amplitude cannot yet exclude. Both readings agree the structure is in [~3e6G, ~1e11G] = 1e17 .. 3e21.
  -  P4 (density fraction C.(g/G)) alone leaves max|res| 2.02e7 (~84% of the drift): the drift is NOT a constant fraction of the leading density. P3 (lognormal bump) tracks the P1 bands (best ~2.4e5 at h0 ~ 1e9G-1e11G, sig ~ 1). P2 (power tails) is poor (>= 4.6e5, typically 1e7).

Part A (min-norm e with the joint solve, Tikhonov lam 1e4, grid L2000/1/n160): the census rows change the min-norm profile only by a near-constant far mass offset (delta-e pointwise below 3e-3) -- the min-norm absorbs the drift along the ln-direction (the expected degeneracy: the kernel approximately reproduces ln t, and a smooth monotone drift sits along that direction). The min-norm alone does not localize the structure; the pole family does.

Verdict (CONTINGENT on the in-flight dps-80 I_far verification of the census rows): the far-side structure behind the drift is a localized positive count offset (or a narrow smooth distribution, P3-comparable) located at g in ~ [3e6G, 1e11G] (1e17 .. 3e21), with an amplitude of O(1e8 .. 1e11) zeros (position-amplitude degenerate at the current row set). It sits far above the G frontier, in the far quadrant the certified ledger does not reach -- exactly the region the program's far-side count statement (W2Telescope DN form) is about.

Next (in flight now): s28 transition-window census, 6 rows at t/G = {5e5, 7e5, 1.5e6, 3e6, 5e6, 7e6} (t up to 2.1e17, below the 1e18 extreme boundary; anchored at both ends by the existing 1e5G/3e5G/1e6G rows). These rows fill the crossing window and break the pole position-amplitude degeneracy: each added row is one more constraint on (h0, amplitude). Launched 2026-10-16 0213 on all 32 threads (PID in tmp/s28_run.log context); ETA ~ stream pass (constant cost, ~35 min) + 6 dps-40 rows (faster than s25's rows, t < 2.1e17).

Also in this entry's scope (meta): the discovery-log reorganization was re-cut to the owner's specification in this same window -- the entries/ directory itself is the source of truth (no manifest file; index.json removed), and each entry's unique identifier is its real date + time (new entries carry real 24h wall-clock times; archive-era bare-date collisions got deterministic s2..sN order tokens; recorded am/pmN day-markers kept). docs/PATHWAY-TO-A-SOLUTION.md remains the single source of truth for STATE.
